Description: Ensure newly created accounts are assigned the bartender role automatically

Description: Create signup API and form allowing new users to register with name; email; and password

Description: Allow managers to see a list of all registered users with their roles and status

Description: Allow managers to suspend a user; preventing login and shift signup

Description: Allow managers to reactivate a previously suspended user

Description: Allow managers to permanently delete a user account and associated data

Description: Allow managers to reset/change a user's password on their behalf
